## 中文原文
今天午休的时候，我打算下楼去咖啡店买一杯热饮。排队的人有点多，等了大概十分钟。拿到咖啡之后，我坐在窗边的位置，拿出手机想简单回几条消息。刚喝两口，就看到同事发来消息，说有个紧急小任务需要我马上处理。我只好快速喝完咖啡，收拾东西赶回办公室。

## My translation
During today's lunch break, I decided to buy a hot drink at the coffee store downstairs.
The waiting line was a bit long, so I waited for about ten minutes to get my coffee, then I sat down by a window.
I'd just wanted to reply several messages with my phone before I got ones from my colleagues.
It said that there was an urgent task that needs me to handle immediately.
I had to finish the coffee quickly, packed up my things and got back to the office.

## Revised version
During my lunch break today, I decided to grab a hot drink at the coffee shop downstairs.
The line was a bit long. I waited around ten minutes for my coffee and then sat by the window.
I was just about to reply a few messages with my phone when I got some from my colleagues.
They said there was an urgent task I needed to deal with right away.
I had to drink my coffee quickly, pack up my stuff and head back to the office.

## Key phrases
- during my lunch break
- grab a hot drink
- wait around ten minutes for my coffee
- was just about to ... when ...
- drink my coffee quickly
- pack up my stuff
